meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会通过 Baileys 直连 WhatsApp Web(不走 Chat SDK 中转)。Claude 会复制适配器、注册、装依赖、构建测试,再引导扫码或配对码登录,并做号码安全检查和模式设置。
howto.when: 当你说“接入 WhatsApp”“加 WhatsApp 频道”等,或要求 NanoClaw 增加 WhatsApp 频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接上 WhatsApp
say.note: 会先做号码安全检查再开始安装

say.text: 用配对码方式连接 WhatsApp
say.note: 会要求输入手机号并显示 8 位配对码

say.text: 我想用个人号码接入 WhatsApp
say.note: 会先展示封号风险警告并请求确认

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw connects to WhatsApp Web via Baileys (no Chat SDK bridge). Claude copies/registers the adapter, installs pinned deps, builds/validates, then guides QR or pairing-code login with safety checks and mode settings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'add WhatsApp', 'connect WhatsApp', or ask to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Starts install with a number safety check.

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp using a pairing code
say_en.note: Asks for phone number and shows an 8-char code.

say_en.text: I want to use my personal WhatsApp number
say_en.note: Shows account-risk warning and asks to confirm.
